name: html-grid-class-name-block-display-stays-flow
description: Regression: a container whose class name contains a grid-looking token (`mz_grid`) but whose cascade resolves no display:grid keeps the flow/default layout. A class name is not evidence of display:grid, so the two full-width sections stay stacked instead of being squeezed into auto-generated grid columns.

source_reference.notes: Reduced from a Mozello site import where every page body is <main class="mz_component mz_grid">, a normal block container; class-name grid inference turned it into display:grid with seven 205px tracks.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
